questionClassificationAudit.limitation: The repository contains no Gemini taxonomy.json, classification-manifest.json, or AI_CONTENT_GUIDE.md. Therefore the exact 688-row Gemini map and exact 28-pool membership cannot be audited line by line. The findings below are independently derived from the live question and group files and from the proposal summary supplied to the auditor.

definiteFormatCorrections.currentEvidence: Members of grp-ana-series-01; group metadata says questionType Number Sequence, while both stems explicitly ask for the next letter and subtopics are Letter Series with Increasing/Decreasing Gaps.
definiteFormatCorrections.recommendedChange: Keep subject Analytical Reasoning and topic Number and Letter Pattern, but classify as questionType=sequence and questionFormat=letter_sequence; do not place them in a numeric-only pool.

contextualSingletons.recommendedTreatment: These items contain self-sufficient, item-local passages, tables, codebooks, or puzzle setups. Keep the stimulus on the question. Treat them as independently sampleable pool questions with an embedded_stimulus flag, or as singleton fixed items in an internal representation; do not invent multi-question groups around them.

confirmedSkillRules.rule: Assumption/conclusion evaluation remains Analytical Reasoning even when wrapped in a short passage.
Word analogy remains Analytical Reasoning under the application’s internal taxonomy.
Clerical coding remains Clerical Ability; an embedded code table does not make the item a fixed multi-question group.

questionClassificationAudit.noEvidenceOfStructuralMisclassification: All 688 records have valid subjects matching their directory, all 33 group memberships resolve, there are no duplicate IDs, no cross-group overlaps, and no group subject mismatches. Semantic correctness of every proposed Gemini row remains unverified because the proposed row-level map is absent.

taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: KEEP the aggregate split provisionally: 670 pool questions, 18 members of 8 fixed-context groups, 33 current groups, 8 fixed groups, and 25 pool-like groups.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: All five aggregate counts are reproduced independently from the live repository. The exact 28 pool definitions are not present and therefore cannot receive unconditional approval.

taxonomyCorrections.currentCategory: Number and Letter Pattern / Number Sequence
taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: SPLIT the questionFormat dimension into numeric_sequence and letter_sequence; correct ana-0038 and ana-0040.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: The first Analytical series group contains six numeric items and two explicit letter-series items but is labeled Number Sequence. A broad topic is acceptable; a numeric-only sampling pool is not.

taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: KEEP the closed topic, but require finer questionType/questionFormat metadata for categorical syllogisms, conditional logic, disjunction, assumption/conclusion, and logic-grid items.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: The 21 grouped logical items are independently answerable but exercise materially different procedures. A future AI should not infer compatibility from the current Set 1/2/3 grouping.

taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: SPLIT format metadata into direct_synonym and synonym_in_context; retain both under Verbal Ability / Vocabulary unless pool-size evidence later justifies separate pools.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: The three Synonyms groups and three Synonyms-in-Context groups are all splittable, but their directions and stems express different tasks. The current group questionType collapses that distinction.

taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: KEEP as Clerical topics and pool-like categories; add format metadata for personal-name filing, business/office-name filing, coding, and spelling-rule subtypes.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: All 25 non-context groups are independently answerable, but the subtopics show multiple compatible formats. The groups must not become permanent Set 1/Set 2 containers.

taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: KEEP the established subject and topic vocabulary; do not collapse all 147 items into one generic GI pool.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: The live bank has ten General Information topics with different statutes, constitutional strands, history, geography, and civic content. Cross-topic merging would make sampling and future AI insertion ambiguous.

taxonomyCorrections.recommendedChange: KEEP subtopic as descriptive fine-grained metadata, not as the canonical pool key.
taxonomyCorrections.reason: The live bank contains many precise one-off subtopics by design. The repository guide explicitly treats topic as closed vocabulary and subtopic as descriptive.

aiGuideCorrections: Add a deterministic decision tree: identify the tested skill first; identify whether the item has an item-local stimulus; then decide independent pool versus shared fixed set; then assign subject, closed topic, questionType, and questionFormat.

Define fixed item set as exact shared context plus two or more dependent questions, with contentBlocks, atomic selection, fixed order, and repeated passage text on each member. A single question with its own passage is not automatically a multi-question fixed set.

Define pool question as independently answerable even when it carries an item-local passage, table, codebook, or puzzle setup. The pool key must reflect compatible solving format, not merely the presence of a passage.

Require explicit rules for Word Analogy → Analytical Reasoning, Assumption/Conclusion → Analytical Reasoning, and Spelling/Filing → Clerical Ability. These are already repository rules and must not drift.

Require questionType and questionFormat to be populated during migration. The current 688 question records have zero explicit questionType values, so the proposed taxonomy cannot be operationalized through current metadata alone.
Preserve the distinction between direct synonyms and synonyms in context, numeric versus letter sequences, and logical-reasoning procedures even when they share a broad topic.
Require General Information references and preserve citations. The current bank has references on all 147 General Information items, 243 references overall, and no source-field values.

Warn future agents that docs/content/JSON_SPEC.md contains stale 424/501-item and four-choice figures; current live facts are 688 questions and five choices. Update guidance only as a separate documentation task after the audit is accepted.
migrationRisks: Do not move, delete, rewrite, renumber, or alter the 688 question records, choices, answer keys, explanations, references, or passages during the next migration step.
Preserve all question IDs, including legacy seed-* IDs, because attempts and history depend on stable identifiers.
Do not delete the 25 pool-like group files until the engine and tests no longer depend on them. They are currently runtime inputs even though they should not define permanent sampling pools.
Keep the eight fixed groups atomic and contiguous. Their 18 members must remain whole in simulation allocation.
Keep item-local passages on their question records. Do not turn the 26 standalone contextual questions into artificial multi-question groups.
Use the existing validator and add migration-specific checks for questionType/questionFormat completeness, pool compatibility, fixed-set references, and source/reference preservation.
Do not trust the proposal’s claimed row-level confidence because the underlying classification manifest is not present in this checkout.

recommendedFinalArchitecture.canonicalQuestions: Keep content/questions/<subject>/<timestamped-batch>.json as the canonical source-of-truth and preserve current provenance-oriented file naming.
recommendedFinalArchitecture.fixedSets: Keep only true shared-context multi-question sets under content/groups/<subject>/<fixed-set>.json. Use atomic/fixed policies and contentBlocks.
recommendedFinalArchitecture.taxonomy: Add content/taxonomy/taxonomy.json containing controlled subjects, topics, questionTypes, questionFormats, pool definitions, and compatibility rules.
recommendedFinalArchitecture.classificationManifest: Add content/taxonomy/classification-manifest.json mapping every question ID to subject, topic, questionType, questionFormat, poolId or fixedSetId, embeddedStimulus, and review status.
recommendedFinalArchitecture.aiGuide: Add content/taxonomy/AI_CONTENT_GUIDE.md with the decision tree, examples, prohibited merges, provenance rules, and migration invariants.
recommendedFinalArchitecture.runtimeIndexes: If needed, generate pool indexes from the manifest rather than making one canonical file per pool. This preserves Git history and allows lazy loading by subject.

independentChecks: 688 unique question records; 688 raw records; zero duplicate IDs.
33 unique groups; 217 grouped questions; 471 singleton questions.
8 groups have shared content blocks plus atomic/fixed policy; 25 groups are splittable/shuffle with no shared blocks.
No missing group question IDs, within-group duplicates, overlapping group memberships, or group subject mismatches.
All five application subject strings match source types and validator rules.
